name: assembly-newshe-39
summary: Rock outcrop on brown dirt, 72 x 56 px from six 2x2 ground pieces: a big flat-topped grey block at the back right, split down the middle by a fissure, with a bright lit edge running diagonally down its left side and a darker face on the right; a row of smaller blocky boulders to its left; a boulder and splinters in front of its right half; tall shards pointing down the screen below it; and a dark shadow on the ground in front of the heap. Shape language: hard, angular, faceted stone (columnar blocks with flat tops, chamfered shoulders and steep sides, like the concept's basalt), matte grey, nothing rounded or bubbly.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: the tallest part of the heap: a flat top (cols 30-60, rows 1-14) about 12-14 px above the ground
steep, faceted sides: a dark face falling off to the left, a darker face on the right (cols 58-65), a mid-grey face in front (rows 14-20)
angular hard stone with crisp edges, not a rounded boulder or a dome
features.note: The baseline's 'big block at the back'; the concept draws it as a tall columnar basalt block.

traits: the bright diagonal line from col 29, row 5 to col 41, row 14 is a crisp edge between the top and the left face
reads as a sharp edge catching the light, the left face below it darker
features.note: A thin bright line along a part is an edge (rubric): the block's top-left edge.

traits: a crack down the middle of the block's top near col 45 (the sprite's light vertical lines there)
cut in: a V-shaped groove between two halves of the top, the right half slightly lower
features.note: The concept splits the block's top into slabs with a crack down the middle.

traits: blocky boulder in front of the block's right half, its left edge lit at col 44
flat top with chamfered shoulders, about 7-9 px tall, lower than the main block
features.note: Baseline: 'boulder in front of the block's right half'.

traits: four blocky boulders left of the main block: left (cols 0-14), upper-left (cols 9-25, rows 11-19), bright (cols 15-27) and grey (cols 23-32)
each a separate angular block with a flat top and steep chamfered sides, about 7-9 px tall, seams (dark gaps) between them
the left boulder's left edge and the bright boulder catch the light
features.note: The concept reads them as a row of columnar blocks stepping down to the left.

traits: a low slab (cols 29-38, rows 19-30) and two tall splinters pointing down the screen (cols 29-37 rows 29-42, cols 37-45 rows 20-38)
angular, narrow and tapering towards their ends, about 5-7 px tall
small low splinters right of and below the front boulder (cols 50-61, rows 18-34) and a chip at cols 45-51, rows 29-36
features.note: Baseline: 'small splinters to its right' and 'a chip at the foot'.

traits: dark shadow painted on the flat dirt in front of (below) the heap, brown dirt around it
flat ground, the sprite's dirt pattern in 2 x 2 px cells
features.note: The shadow's length (10-15 px below the rocks) says how tall the heap is.
